steps.text: Hello! I am your AI Guide. I will guide you through each step of the experiment. Please follow the instructions carefully and perform the actions as directed. Before we begin, let us familiarize ourselves with the simulation interface. To start, click on the start walkthrough

The interface walkthrough is now complete. You are now ready to perform the experiment. You may either click the Auto Connect button to make the circuit connections automatically or connect the circuit manually by following the highlighted terminals. Let's begin with the first connection.
Connect the DC power supply to the circuit by clicking and drag the wire from terminal 1 and drop it on terminal 9
Let's move on to the next connection. Connect terminal 2 to terminal 10.
steps.audio: ./audios/Let's move on to the next connection.wav

steps.text: Now, connect terminal 3 of the ammeter to terminal 11.
steps.audio: ./audios/Now, connect terminal 3 of the ammeter to terminal 11.wav

steps.text: Connect terminal 4 to terminal 12.
Connect terminal 5 to terminal 13.
Connect terminal 6 to terminal 14.
Connect terminal 7 to terminal 15.
Connect terminal 8 to terminal 16.
All connections are completed. Click on the Check button to verify the connections.
This connection is wrong.
Some connections are wrong.
Please make the required connections as per the given instructions.
Autoconnect completed. Click on the check button to verify the connections.
Please add at least six readings to plot the graph.
Please add at least six readings to plot the graph.
Please complete or check the connections first to turn on the power supply.
Connections Verified successfully. Now set the required resistance value by moving the resistance sliders.
Please set R1, R2 and R3 by moving the resistance sliders before turning ON the power supply.
The resistance values for R₁, R₂, and R₃ have been set. Click on the Power to turn ON the power supply.
Power supply has been turned ON. Now, set the voltage by moving the voltage slider.
The readings are displayed on the ammeters. Now, click on the add button to add the readings to the observation table.
Readings added successfully. To record the second reading, change the voltage and click the Add button again.
Duplicate Readings: This reading is already added to the table. Change the voltage value and take the next reading.
Second reading added successfully. Change the voltage value and click the Add button again to record the next reading. Repeat these steps until at least six readings are recorded.
You have added six readings. Now you can plot the graph by clicking on the graph button or add more readings to the table.
All ten readings have been recorded. Now plot the graph and then click on the generate report button to generate your report.
You can add a maximum of ten readings to the table. Now, click the Graph button.

The graph of current vs voltage has been plotted successfully. Your simulation is now complete. You may view the report by clicking on the generate report button, then use print to print the page or reset to start the simulation again.
The simulation has been reset. You can start again.
Opening the print dialog.
Report Generated: Your report has been generated successfully. Click OK to view your report.
